```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(plotly)
library(googlesheets4)
library(reactable)
library(htmltools)
library(DT)

# ============================
# CONFIG
# ============================
# Auth: GOOGLE_SA_JSON (full JSON string) for Posit Connect; GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH for local dev
GOOGLE_SA_JSON <- Sys.getenv("GOOGLE_SA_JSON", unset = "")
GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH <- Sys.getenv("GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH", unset = "")
SHORTCUT_TICKETS <- Sys.getenv("SHORTCUT_TICKETS", unset = "")
SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_BUGS <- Sys.getenv("SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_BUGS", unset = "Bugs")
SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_FEATURES <- Sys.getenv("SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_FEATURES", unset = "Features")
SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_CHORES <- Sys.getenv("SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_CHORES", unset = "Chores")
SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_RELEASES <- Sys.getenv("SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_RELEASES", unset = "Releases")
SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_BUGS_RANGE <- Sys.getenv("SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_BUGS_RANGE", unset = "A:J")
SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_FEATURES_RANGE <- Sys.getenv("SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_FEATURES_RANGE", unset = "A:H")
SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_CHORES_RANGE <- Sys.getenv("SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_CHORES_RANGE", unset = "A:H")
SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_RELEASES_RANGE <- Sys.getenv("SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_RELEASES_RANGE", unset = "A:C")

TIME_DATA_SHEET_ID <- Sys.getenv("TIME_DATA_SHEET_ID", unset = "")
TIME_DATA_SHEET_TAB <- Sys.getenv("TIME_DATA_SHEET_TAB", unset = "State")
TIME_DATA_SHEET_RANGE <- Sys.getenv("TIME_DATA_SHEET_RANGE", unset = "A:J")

# ============================
# DESIGN SYSTEM
# ============================
SEVERITY_COLORS <- c(
  "Need Triage"   = "#7F7F7F",  # neutral gray
  "S3 - Low"      = "#009E73",  # green (safe)
  "S2 - Medium"   = "#0072B2",  # blue
  "S1 - High"     = "#E69F00",  # orange
  "S0 - Critical" = "#D55E00"   # vermillion (NOT pure red)
)

# Customer impact indicator colors
CUSTOMER_IMPACT_COLORS <- c(
  "Customer Facing" = "#D55E00",  # vermillion - high visibility
  "Internal Only"   = "#009E73"   # green - internal
)

HIERARCHY_COLORS <- c(
  "Regular Bug"  = "#E69F00",
  "Sub-task Bug" = "#009E73"
)

SEVERITY_STACK_ORDER <- c(
  "S3 - Low", "S2 - Medium", "S1 - High", "S0 - Critical", "Need Triage"
)

HOTFIX_COLORS <- c(
  "Hotfix"            = "#E69F00",  # orange
  "Non-Impact Hotfix" = "#009E73"   # green
)

severity_levels <- c(
  "S0 - Critical",
  "S1 - High",
  "S2 - Medium",
  "S3 - Low",
  "Need Triage"
)

# Completed work colors (monthly completions by type; Wong-style palette)
WORKTYPE_COLORS <- c(
  "Bug"          = "#D55E00",  # vermillion
  "Sub-Task Bug" = "#56B4E9",  # sky blue (distinct from Feature blue; colorblind-friendly)
  "Feature"      = "#0072B2",  # blue
  "Chore"        = "#009E73"   # bluish green
)

PRODUCT_COLORS <- c(
  "Tax"            = "#CC79A7",  # purple
  "Roth"           = "#56B4E9",  # sky blue
  "Platform"       = "#009E73",  # bluish green
  "Insurance/P&C"  = "#0072B2",  # blue
  "Estate"         = "#E69F00",  # orange
  "Automation"     = "#D55E00",  # vermillion
  "Unspecified"    = "#7F7F7F"   # gray
)

BASE_THEME <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#1f1f1f", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#1f1f1f", color = NA),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#333333"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(color = "#e6e6e6"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#cccccc"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "#cccccc"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#aaaaaa"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#1f1f1f"),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "#1f1f1f"),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#e6e6e6"),
    legend.title = element_text(color = "#e6e6e6")
  )

# ============================
# PLOTLY TITLE + BORDER HELPERS
# ============================
plotly_title <- function(text) {
  list(
    text = paste0("<b>", text, "</b>"),
    x = 0.02,
    xanchor = "left",
    font = list(size = 14, color = "#e6e6e6")
  )
}

add_plotly_border <- function(p, color = "#e6e6e6", width = 1) {
  p %>% layout(
    shapes = list(
      list(
        type = "rect",
        xref = "paper", yref = "paper",
        x0 = 0, y0 = 0, x1 = 1, y1 = 1,
        line = list(color = color, width = width),
        fillcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)"
      )
    )
  )
}

normalize_severity <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- stringr::str_trim(x)
  x[x %in% c("", NA, "NA")] <- "Need Triage"

  dplyr::recode(x,
    "Severity 0" = "S0 - Critical",
    "Severity 1" = "S1 - High",
    "Severity 2" = "S2 - Medium",
    "Severity 3" = "S3 - Low",
    "S0" = "S0 - Critical",
    "S1" = "S1 - High",
    "S2" = "S2 - Medium",
    "S3" = "S3 - Low",
    .default = x
  )
}

# ============================
# REACTABLE THEME + BADGES (STATIC FRIENDLY)
# ============================
REACTABLE_THEME_DARK <- reactableTheme(
  color = "#e6e6e6",
  backgroundColor = "#1f1f1f",
  borderColor = "#333333",
  stripedColor = "#242424",
  highlightColor = "#2b2b2b",
  cellPadding = "10px 12px",
  style = list(fontSize = "13px"),
  headerStyle = list(
    backgroundColor = "#1a1a1a",
    color = "#e6e6e6",
    borderColor = "#333333",
    fontWeight = 600
  ),
  tableBodyStyle = list(borderColor = "#333333")
)

severity_badge <- function(value) {
  val <- as.character(value)
  col <- SEVERITY_COLORS[[val]]
  if (is.null(col)) col <- "#777777"

  htmltools::div(
    style = list(
      display = "inline-block",
      padding = "3px 10px",
      borderRadius = "999px",
      background = col,
      color = "#111111",
      fontWeight = 700,
      fontSize = "12px",
      lineHeight = "18px"
    ),
    val
  )
}


# ---------- Readers ----------
read_bugs <- function() {
  googlesheets4::read_sheet(
    ss = SHORTCUT_TICKETS,
    sheet = SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_BUGS,
    range = SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_BUGS_RANGE,
    col_types = "c"
  )
}

read_features <- function() {
  googlesheets4::read_sheet(
    ss = SHORTCUT_TICKETS,
    sheet = SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_FEATURES,
    range = SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_FEATURES_RANGE,
    col_types = "c"
  )
}

read_chores <- function() {
  googlesheets4::read_sheet(
    ss = SHORTCUT_TICKETS,
    sheet = SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_CHORES,
    range = SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_CHORES_RANGE,
    col_types = "c"
  )
}

read_releases <- function() {
  googlesheets4::read_sheet(
    ss = SHORTCUT_TICKETS,
    sheet = SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_RELEASES,
    range = SHORTCUT_TICKETS_TAB_RELEASES_RANGE,
    col_types = "c"
  )
}

# ---------- Cleaners ----------
clean_bugs <- function(df) {
  if (!("Labels" %in% names(df))) df$Labels <- NA_character_

  df %>%
    mutate(
      `Created At` = parse_date_time(
        `Created At`,
        orders = c("ymd HMS", "mdy HMS", "ymd HM", "mdy HM", "ymd", "mdy"),
        tz = "UTC"
      ),
      Severity = normalize_severity(Severity),
      Product  = if_else(is.na(Product) | Product == "", "Unspecified", str_trim(Product)),
      Hierarchy_Type = if_else(is.na(`Parent ID`) | `Parent ID` == "", "Regular Bug", "Sub-task Bug"),
      Has_CX_Issue = !is.na(Labels) & stringr::str_detect(Labels, stringr::fixed("CX Issue"))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(`Created At`))
}

clean_completed <- function(df, type_label) {
  if (!("Completed At" %in% names(df))) df$`Completed At` <- NA_character_
  if (!("Story Points" %in% names(df))) df$`Story Points` <- NA_character_

  df %>%
    mutate(
      Type = type_label,
      `Completed At` = parse_date_time(
        `Completed At`,
        orders = c("ymd HMS", "mdy HMS", "ymd HM", "mdy HM", "ymd", "mdy"),
        tz = "UTC"
      ),
      Story_Points = suppressWarnings(readr::parse_number(as.character(`Story Points`))),
      Story_Points = replace_na(Story_Points, 0),
      Month = floor_date(`Completed At`, "month")
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(`Completed At`))
}

read_qa_snapshots <- function() {
  googlesheets4::read_sheet(
    ss = TIME_DATA_SHEET_ID,
    sheet = TIME_DATA_SHEET_TAB,
    range = TIME_DATA_SHEET_RANGE,
    col_types = "c"
  )
}

clean_releases <- function(df) {
  date_col <- names(df)[tolower(names(df)) == "date"][1]
  type_col <- names(df)[tolower(names(df)) == "type"][1]
  if (is.na(date_col) || is.na(type_col)) return(tibble(Date = as.Date(character()), Type = character()))

  df %>%
    mutate(
      Date = parse_date_time(
        as.character(.data[[date_col]]),
        orders = c("mdy", "ymd", "mdy HMS", "ymd HMS", "mdy HM", "ymd HM"),
        tz = "UTC"
      ),
      Date = as.Date(Date),
      Type = stringr::str_trim(as.character(.data[[type_col]]))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Date), !is.na(Type)) %>%
    mutate(
      Type = case_when(
        tolower(Type) == "hotfix"            ~ "Hotfix",
        tolower(Type) == "non-impact hotfix" ~ "Non-Impact Hotfix",
        TRUE                                  ~ Type
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(Type %in% c("Hotfix", "Non-Impact Hotfix")) %>%
    select(Date, Type)
}

clean_qa_snapshots <- function(df) {
  if (!("Date/Time" %in% names(df))) {
    dt_col <- names(df)[tolower(names(df)) %in% c("date/time", "datetime", "date time", "timestamp")]
    if (length(dt_col) == 1) names(df)[names(df) == dt_col] <- "Date/Time"
  }

  df %>%
    mutate(
      `Date/Time` = parse_date_time(
        `Date/Time`,
        orders = c("mdy HMS", "mdy HM", "ymd HMS", "ymd HM", "ymd", "mdy"),
        tz = "UTC"
      ),
      `Bugs - Unscheduled` = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Bugs - Unscheduled`)),
      `Bugs - Ready for Development` = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Bugs - Ready for Development`)),
      `In Development` = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`In Development`)),
      `Ready for Review` = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`Ready for Review`)),
      `In QA` = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(`In QA`))
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(`Date/Time`)) %>%
    arrange(`Date/Time`)
}
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
# ============================
# STATIC SNAPSHOT (READ ONCE PER KNIT)
# ============================
auth_gs <- function() {
  if (nzchar(GOOGLE_SA_JSON)) {
    googlesheets4::gs4_auth(path = GOOGLE_SA_JSON)
  } else if (nzchar(GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH) && file.exists(GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH)) {
    googlesheets4::gs4_auth(path = GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH)
  } else {
    stop("Set GOOGLE_SA_JSON (Posit Connect) or GOOGLE_SA_JSON_PATH (local) with valid credentials")
  }
}
auth_gs()

BUGS_RAW     <- read_bugs()
FEATURES_RAW <- read_features()
CHORES_RAW   <- read_chores()
RELEASES_RAW <- tryCatch(read_releases(), error = function(e) tibble(Date = character(), Type = character()))
QA_RAW       <- read_qa_snapshots()

BUGS_DATA     <- BUGS_RAW %>% clean_bugs()
RELEASES_DATA <- RELEASES_RAW %>% clean_releases()
QA_STATE_DATA <- QA_RAW %>% clean_qa_snapshots()

# Bugs: top-level vs sub-task (Parent ID empty/missing => Bug; else Sub-Task Bug)
bugs_for_completed <- BUGS_RAW
if (!("Parent ID" %in% names(bugs_for_completed))) {
  bugs_for_completed$`Parent ID` <- NA_character_
}
bugs_top_level <- bugs_for_completed %>%
  filter(is.na(`Parent ID`) | `Parent ID` == "")
bugs_subtasks <- bugs_for_completed %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Parent ID`) & `Parent ID` != "")

COMPLETED_WORK_DATA <- bind_rows(
  clean_completed(bugs_top_level, "Bug"),
  clean_completed(bugs_subtasks, "Sub-Task Bug"),
  clean_completed(FEATURES_RAW, "Feature"),
  clean_completed(CHORES_RAW, "Chore")
) %>%
  mutate(Story_Points = replace_na(Story_Points, 0))
```

```{r monthly_bugs_severity}
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)

SEVERITY_ORDER <- c("S3 - Low", "S2 - Medium", "S1 - High", "S0 - Critical", "Need Triage")

SEVERITY_COLORS <- c(
  "Need Triage"   = "#7F7F7F",  # neutral gray
  "S3 - Low"      = "#009E73",  # green (safe)
  "S2 - Medium"   = "#0072B2",  # blue
  "S1 - High"     = "#E69F00",  # orange
  "S0 - Critical" = "#D55E00"   # vermillion (NOT pure red)
)

end_month   <- floor_date(Sys.Date(), "month")
start_month <- end_month %m-% months(11)
month_seq   <- seq.Date(start_month, end_month, by = "1 month")

df <- BUGS_DATA %>%
  mutate(
    Month = floor_date(`Created At`, "month"),
    Severity = factor(Severity, levels = SEVERITY_ORDER)
  ) %>%
  filter(Month >= start_month, Month <= end_month)

if (nrow(df) == 0) {

  plotly_empty(type = "scatter") %>%
    layout(title = plotly_title("Monthly Bugs by Severity (Last 12 Months)"))

} else {

  agg <- df %>%
    count(Month, Severity, name = "n") %>%
    complete(Month = month_seq, Severity = SEVERITY_ORDER, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    arrange(Month, Severity)

  plt <- plot_ly()

  for (sev in SEVERITY_ORDER) {

    d <- agg %>% filter(Severity == sev)

    plt <- plt %>%
      add_trace(
        data = d,
        x = ~Month,
        y = ~n,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines",
        line = list(color = SEVERITY_COLORS[[sev]], width = 0.5),
        stackgroup = "one",
        name = sev,
        fillcolor = SEVERITY_COLORS[[sev]]
      )
  }

  plt %>%
    layout(
      title = plotly_title("Monthly Bugs by Severity (Last 12 Months)"),
      plot_bgcolor = "#1f1f1f",
      paper_bgcolor = "#1f1f1f",
      xaxis = list(type = "date", dtick = "M1", showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = "#333333"),
      yaxis = list(showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = "#333333"),
      legend = list(font = list(color = "#ffffff"))
    )
}
```

```{r}
end_month   <- floor_date(Sys.Date(), "month")
start_month <- end_month %m-% months(11)
month_seq   <- seq.Date(start_month, end_month, by = "1 month")

df <- BUGS_DATA %>%
  mutate(Month = floor_date(`Created At`, "month")) %>%
  filter(Month >= start_month, Month <= end_month)

if (nrow(df) == 0) {
  plotly_empty(type = "scatter") %>%
    layout(title = plotly_title("Monthly Bugs by Product (Last 12 Months)"))
} else {

  product_levels <- names(PRODUCT_COLORS)
  product_colors <- PRODUCT_COLORS
  if ("Unspecified" %in% names(product_colors)) {
    product_colors["Unspecified"] <- "#777777"
  }

  agg <- df %>%
    count(Month, Product, name = "n") %>%
    complete(Month = month_seq, Product = product_levels, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
    arrange(Month, Product)

  plt <- plot_ly()
  for (prod in product_levels) {
    d <- agg %>% filter(Product == prod)
    plt <- plt %>%
      add_trace(
        data = d,
        x = ~Month,
        y = ~n,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "lines",
        line = list(color = product_colors[[prod]], width = 0.5),
        stackgroup = "one",
        name = prod,
        fillcolor = product_colors[[prod]],
        hovertemplate = paste0(
          "Month: %{x|%Y-%b}<br>",
          "Bugs: %{y}<br>",
          "Product: ", prod,
          "<extra></extra>"
        )
      )
  }

  plt %>%
    layout(
      title = plotly_title("Monthly Bugs by Product (Last 12 Months)"),
      plot_bgcolor = "#1f1f1f",
      paper_bgcolor = "#1f1f1f",
      xaxis = list(
        type = "date",
        tickformat = "%Y-%b",
        dtick = "M1",
        tick0 = format(start_month, "%Y-%m-%d"),
        showgrid = TRUE,
        gridcolor = "#333333"
      ),
      yaxis = list(showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = "#333333"),
      legend = list(font = list(color = "#ffffff"))
    )
}
```

```{r product_tab_data_prep, include=FALSE}
prep_created_with_product <- function(df, type_label) {
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      `Created At` = as.POSIXct(character(), tz = "UTC"),
      Product = character(),
      Type = character()
    ))
  }

  if (!("Created At" %in% names(df))) df$`Created At` <- NA_character_
  if (!("Product"    %in% names(df))) df$Product       <- NA_character_

  df %>%
    mutate(
      `Created At` = parse_date_time(
        `Created At`,
        orders = c("ymd HMS", "mdy HMS", "ymd HM", "mdy HM", "ymd", "mdy"),
        tz = "UTC"
      ),
      Product = if_else(is.na(Product) | Product == "", "Unspecified", str_trim(Product)),
      Type = type_label
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(`Created At`)) %>%
    select(`Created At`, Product, Type)
}

bugs_top_level_created <- bugs_for_completed %>%
  filter(is.na(`Parent ID`) | `Parent ID` == "")
bugs_subtasks_created <- bugs_for_completed %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Parent ID`) & `Parent ID` != "")

CREATED_TICKETS_BY_PRODUCT <- bind_rows(
  prep_created_with_product(bugs_top_level_created, "Bug"),
  prep_created_with_product(bugs_subtasks_created,  "Sub-Task Bug"),
  prep_created_with_product(FEATURES_RAW,           "Feature"),
  prep_created_with_product(CHORES_RAW,             "Chore")
) %>%
  mutate(Month = floor_date(`Created At`, "month"))

plot_tickets_by_type_for_products <- function(products, title_text) {
  end_month   <- floor_date(Sys.Date(), "month")
  start_month <- end_month %m-% months(11)
  month_seq   <- seq.Date(start_month, end_month, by = "1 month")

  type_levels <- names(WORKTYPE_COLORS)

  df <- CREATED_TICKETS_BY_PRODUCT %>%
    filter(Product %in% products) %>%
    mutate(Type = factor(Type, levels = type_levels)) %>%
    filter(Month >= start_month, Month <= end_month)

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(
      plotly_empty(type = "bar") %>%
        layout(title = plotly_title(title_text))
    )
  }

  agg <- df %>%
    count(Month, Type, name = "Count") %>%
    complete(Month = month_seq, Type = type_levels, fill = list(Count = 0)) %>%
    arrange(Month, Type)

  plt <- plot_ly()
  for (t in type_levels) {
    d <- agg %>% filter(Type == t)
    plt <- plt %>%
      add_trace(
        data = d,
        x = ~Month,
        y = ~Count,
        type = "bar",
        name = t,
        marker = list(color = WORKTYPE_COLORS[[t]]),
        hovertemplate = paste0(
          "Month: %{x|%Y-%b}<br>",
          "Type: ", t, "<br>",
          "Tickets: %{y}<extra></extra>"
        )
      )
  }

  plt %>%
    layout(
      barmode = "stack",
      title = plotly_title(title_text),
      plot_bgcolor = "#1f1f1f",
      paper_bgcolor = "#1f1f1f",
      margin = list(b = 60),
      xaxis = list(
        type = "date",
        tickformat = "%Y-%b",
        dtick = "M1",
        tick0 = format(start_month, "%Y-%m-%d"),
        showgrid = TRUE,
        gridcolor = "#333333"
      ),
      yaxis = list(
        title = "Tickets Created",
        showgrid = TRUE,
        gridcolor = "#333333",
        rangemode = "tozero"
      ),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0.02, y = -0.15)
    )
}
```

Critical/High
=====================================

Row {data-height=150}
-------------------------------------

### Customer-Facing Bug Impact

```{r customer_impact_kpis}
# Estimate customer-facing bugs based on product and severity
customer_facing_products <- c("Tax", "Roth", "Insurance/P&C", "Estate")

df <- BUGS_DATA %>%
  mutate(
    Is_Customer_Facing = Product %in% customer_facing_products | Severity %in% c("S0 - Critical", "S1 - High")
  )

total_bugs <- nrow(df)
customer_facing_count <- sum(df$Is_Customer_Facing, na.rm = TRUE)
customer_pct <- if (total_bugs > 0) customer_facing_count / total_bugs else 0

valueBox(
  value = customer_facing_count,
  caption = vb_caption(
    "Customer-Facing Bugs",
    paste0("Bugs in customer products or S0/S1 severity")
  ),
  color = ifelse(customer_pct <= 0.20, "success", ifelse(customer_pct <= 0.40, "warning", "danger"))
)

# Customer-facing by severity
customer_by_sev <- df %>%
  filter(Is_Customer_Facing == TRUE) %>%
  count(Severity, name = "Count")

s0_cust <- customer_by_sev %>% filter(Severity == "S0 - Critical") %>% pull(Count) %>% sum(na.rm = TRUE)
s1_cust <- customer_by_sev %>% filter(Severity == "S1 - High") %>% pull(Count) %>% sum(na.rm = TRUE)

valueBox(
  value = s0_cust + s1_cust,
  caption = vb_caption(
    "Critical/High (Customer)",
    paste0(s0_cust, " S0 + ", s1_cust, " S1 in customer products")
  ),
  color = ifelse(s0_cust + s1_cust == 0, "success", "warning")
)

# S0/S1 as percentage of customer-facing
s0_s1_pct <- if (customer_facing_count > 0) (s0_cust + s1_cust) / customer_facing_count else 0
valueBox(
  value = scales::percent(s0_s1_pct, accuracy = 1),
  caption = vb_caption(
    "S0/S1 Rate",
    "Critical/High as % of customer-facing bugs"
  ),
  color = ifelse(s0_s1_pct <= 0.10, "success", ifelse(s0_s1_pct <= 0.25, "warning", "danger"))
)
```

### Severity 0–1 Bugs in (Unscheduled/Ready for Development) OR Open > 1 Week

```{r}
week_cutoff <- lubridate::floor_date(Sys.time(), unit = "day") - lubridate::days(7)
closed_states <- c("done", "closed", "completed", "complete")

df <- BUGS_DATA

# Exclude sub-task bugs (only show top-level bugs on this page)
if ("Parent ID" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- df %>% filter(is.na(`Parent ID`) | `Parent ID` == "")
}

# Defensive cleaning for filtering
df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    `Story Type` = if ("Story Type" %in% names(.)) as.character(`Story Type`) else NA_character_,
    State = if ("State" %in% names(.)) stringr::str_trim(as.character(State)) else NA_character_,
    Severity_raw = normalize_severity(Severity),
    Severity_raw = stringr::str_trim(as.character(Severity_raw)),
    Product = if_else(is.na(Product) | Product == "", "Unspecified", str_trim(Product)),
    Age_Days = as.integer(difftime(Sys.time(), `Created At`, units = "days"))
  ) %>%
  filter(stringr::str_detect(Severity_raw, "^S[01]\\b"))

# Set A: All Sev 0/1 in Unscheduled or Ready for Development (any age)
set_a <- df
if ("State" %in% names(set_a)) {
  set_a <- set_a %>% filter(tolower(State) %in% c("unscheduled", "ready for development"))
}

# Set B: Sev 0/1 that are open (not closed) and older than 1 week
set_b <- df %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(`Created At`),
    `Created At` < week_cutoff
  )
if ("State" %in% names(set_b)) {
  set_b <- set_b %>% filter(is.na(State) | !tolower(State) %in% closed_states)
}

# Union (distinct by Ticket ID)
df <- bind_rows(set_a, set_b) %>%
  distinct(`Ticket ID`, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(`Ticket ID`, Name, Severity = Severity_raw, Product, State, `Created At`, Age_Days) %>%
  arrange(factor(Severity, levels = c("S0 - Critical", "S1 - High")), desc(Age_Days), Product, State)

if (nrow(df) == 0) {
  cat("No S0/S1 backlog bugs found.")
} else {
  reactable(
    df,
    theme = REACTABLE_THEME_DARK,
    searchable = FALSE,
    pagination = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 10,
    highlight = TRUE,
    bordered = TRUE,
    compact = TRUE,
    defaultSorted = "Age_Days",
    defaultSortOrder = "desc",
    defaultColDef = colDef(vAlign = "top"),
    columns = list(
      `Ticket ID`  = colDef(width = 90),
      Name         = colDef(minWidth = 520, style = list(whiteSpace = "normal")),
      Severity     = colDef(width = 130, cell = function(value) severity_badge(value)),
      Product      = colDef(width = 150),
      State        = colDef(width = 190),
      `Created At` = colDef(
        width = 170,
        cell = function(value) if (is.na(value)) "" else format(value, "%Y-%m-%d")
      ),
      Age_Days     = colDef(width = 110, name = "Age (days)")
    )
  )
}
```

### Backlog Bugs Older Than 6 Months

```{r}
cutoff <- lubridate::floor_date(Sys.time(), unit = "day") %m-% months(6)

df <- BUGS_DATA

if ("Story Type" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- df %>% filter(tolower(stringr::str_trim(as.character(`Story Type`))) == "bug")
}

# Exclude sub-task bugs (only show top-level bugs on this page)
if ("Parent ID" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- df %>% filter(is.na(`Parent ID`) | `Parent ID` == "")
}

if ("State" %in% names(df)) {
  df <- df %>% filter(tolower(stringr::str_trim(as.character(State))) %in% c("unscheduled", "ready for development"))
}

df <- df %>%
  mutate(
    Severity_raw = normalize_severity(Severity),
    Severity_raw = stringr::str_trim(as.character(Severity_raw)),
    Product = if_else(is.na(Product) | Product == "", "Unspecified", str_trim(Product))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Created At`), `Created At` < cutoff) %>%
  mutate(Age_Days = as.integer(difftime(Sys.time(), `Created At`, units = "days"))) %>%
  select(`Ticket ID`, Name, Severity = Severity_raw, Product, State, `Created At`, Age_Days) %>%
  arrange(desc(Age_Days))

if (nrow(df) == 0) {
  cat("No backlog bugs older than 6 months found.")
} else {
  reactable(
    df,
    theme = REACTABLE_THEME_DARK,
    searchable = FALSE,
    pagination = TRUE,
    defaultPageSize = 10,
    highlight = TRUE,
    bordered = TRUE,
    compact = TRUE,
    defaultSorted = "Age_Days",
    defaultSortOrder = "desc",
    defaultColDef = colDef(vAlign = "top"),
    columns = list(
      `Ticket ID`  = colDef(width = 90),
      Name         = colDef(minWidth = 520, style = list(whiteSpace = "normal")),
      Severity     = colDef(width = 130, cell = function(value) severity_badge(value)),
      Product      = colDef(width = 150),
      State        = colDef(width = 190),
      `Created At` = colDef(
        width = 170,
        cell = function(value) if (is.na(value)) "" else format(value, "%Y-%m-%d")
      ),
      Age_Days     = colDef(width = 110)
    )
  )
}
```

```{r}
df <- QA_STATE_DATA %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Date/Time`)) %>%
  arrange(`Date/Time`)

if (nrow(df) == 0) {
  plotly_empty(type = "scatter") %>% layout(title = plotly_title("Work in Progress: Dev, Review, QA"))
} else {

  col_dev    <- "#0072B2"  # blue
  col_review <- "#E69F00"  # orange
  col_qa     <- "#009E73"  # bluish green
  col_goal   <- "#882255"  # Paul Tol wine; CB-safe, distinct from series above
  qa_goal_n  <- 10

  plot_ly(data = df, x = ~`Date/Time`) %>%
    add_trace(
      y = ~`In Development`,
      name = "In Development",
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      line = list(color = col_dev, width = 3),
      marker = list(color = col_dev, size = 5),
      hovertemplate = paste0(
        "%{x|%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}<br>",
        "In Development: %{y}<extra></extra>"
      )
    ) %>%
    add_trace(
      y = ~`Ready for Review`,
      name = "Ready for Review",
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      line = list(color = col_review, width = 3),
      marker = list(color = col_review, size = 5),
      hovertemplate = paste0(
        "%{x|%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}<br>",
        "Ready for Review: %{y}<extra></extra>"
      )
    ) %>%
    add_trace(
      y = ~`In QA`,
      name = "In QA",
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines+markers",
      line = list(color = col_qa, width = 3),
      marker = list(color = col_qa, size = 5),
      hovertemplate = paste0(
        "%{x|%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S}<br>",
        "In QA: %{y}<extra></extra>"
      )
    ) %>%
    add_trace(
      x = range(df$`Date/Time`, na.rm = TRUE),
      y = c(qa_goal_n, qa_goal_n),
      name = paste0("Goal (", qa_goal_n, ")"),
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "lines",
      line = list(color = col_goal, width = 2, dash = "dash"),
      hovertemplate = paste0("Goal: ", qa_goal_n, "<extra></extra>"),
      showlegend = TRUE
    ) %>%
    layout(
      title = plotly_title("Work in Progress: Dev, Review, QA"),
      plot_bgcolor = "#1f1f1f",
      paper_bgcolor = "#1f1f1f",
      xaxis = list(type = "date", showgrid = TRUE, gridcolor = "#333333"),
      yaxis = list(
        title = "Ticket Count",
        type = "linear",
        showgrid = TRUE,
        gridcolor = "#333333",
        rangemode = "tozero"
      ),
      legend = list(
        orientation = "h",
        x = 0.5,
        y = -0.15,
        xanchor = "center"
      ),
      annotations = list(
        list(
          xref = "paper",
          x = 0.02,
          yref = "y",
          y = qa_goal_n,
          text = paste0("Goal (", qa_goal_n, ")"),
          showarrow = FALSE,
          xanchor = "left",
          font = list(color = col_goal, size = 11),
          bgcolor = "rgba(31,31,31,0.88)",
          bordercolor = col_goal,
          borderwidth = 1,
          borderpad = 4
        )
      )
    )
}
```

```{r}
df <- QA_STATE_DATA %>%
  mutate(
    backlog_total = coalesce(`Bugs - Unscheduled`, 0) +
      coalesce(`Bugs - Ready for Development`, 0)

if (nrow(df) == 0 || all(is.na(df$backlog_total))) {
  plotly_empty(type = "scatter") %>% layout(title = plotly_title("Total Backlog Bugs Over Time"))

      )
    )
```
